_comment: VIDEO generation. A MOTION brief, not a face description: the face comes
from the still render, which is why still.json is generated first.
Re-describing the face in text is how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
assistant's display name, because names are placeholders that can be
replaced. When renaming, pick a name that fits THIS file, not the reverse.

reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Never pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

identity_lock: beauty spot at the right jawline

performance.energy: steady and reassuring; the host who makes a nervous student feel it is fine to ask
performance.spoken_register: clear, unhurried South African English, gently warm; never bubbly, never formal
performance.body: sits or stands relaxed, leaning very slightly forward as if paying close attention; hands often resting one over the other, gesturing small when she speaks
performance.expression: calm and encouraging, a small closed-mouth smile - the face of someone who is not going to rush you

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, hairstyle and accessories across a campaign; regenerate from the reference image rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this assistant's own scripts (intro/, handover/, signoff/, timekeeping/)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a host

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. THE PERSON FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGE - do not restyle the face, hair, clothing or age. Energy: steady and reassuring; the host who makes a nervous student feel it is fine to ask Delivery: clear, unhurried South African English, gently warm; never bubbly, never formal Plain studio backdrop, softly out of focus. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural handheld micro-movement, real-photography look, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, corporate stock-photo headset, call-centre imagery, generic stock-photo smile
_identity_lock_note: COPIED from still.json continuity_anchors - never edited here. The face lives in the reference render; duplicating its description is how the two files drift apart.
_no_face_description: This file must NEVER describe the face, hair, wardrobe or age - that belongs to still.json and the reference render.
